description: What the apps' check-your-email screen does on Confirm with what's in its code field (apps/docs/SPEC.md FR-1.4): nothing but whitespace (Unicode's White_Space property) asks the server whether the code, typed on the web, confirmed the address ("check"); anything else is sent trimmed of that whitespace for the server to judge ({ submit }).

cases.name: surrounding whitespace is trimmed, inner spaces kept
a short or odd code is still the server's to refuse
spaces, a tab and a no-break space check
a next-line character is whitespace, trimmed
a control character isn't whitespace, kept
